title: WATER CREWS WORKING TO REPAIR A WATER MAIN BREAK ON LAFORTE AVENUE
summary: Syracuse Department of Water is repairing a 36-inch water main break at Laforte Avenue and Arthur Street. Arthur Street will be closed to vehicle traffic for 3-5 hours, with potential water service disruptions and low pressure across the city during repairs. Sidewalks remain open with traffic detours in place.
